coverage_notes: All fourteen handler bodies were read end to end; none is labelled unread.
Only four of the fourteen are called by the 299 installed mission scripts. The ten others, including every group handler, AICreate and AIReloadGlobals, rest on the listing alone.
No run-time evidence: bsp_game.exe does not reach these handlers, which run only under a loaded mission script.
AIGetGroupInfo's result count is not established because 00a2eee0 was not read past its gate.
AISetTargetWeight's record byte layout is not established because 00a32500 was not read in full; the header carries the fields in write order and says so.
open_questions: 00f8a8bc and 00f8a8c8 are twelve bytes apart, yet 009ffc80 can answer 3..6. Either those slots are unreachable here or the shipped build writes out of bounds. Reading 00a335d0, the globals loader, would settle it.
Whether AIGetGroupInfo leaves its table on the Lua stack depends on 00a2eee0.
The target-weight model itself is 00a08460, the largest body this packet touched and left unread.
